identity.name: British Journal of Sports Medicine
identity.source_note: Live BJSM guide at https://bjsm.bmj.com/pages/authors/ was bot-blocked (HTTP 403); web.archive.org and archive.ph were both unreachable from this tool (no archive snapshot could be fetched). BJSM-specific values (article-type word limits, abstract word limit, exact abstract section labels, declaration order) are UNVERIFIED and left null. Formatting, reference and figure values were encoded from the authoritative cross-journal BMJ author hub https://authors.bmj.com/writing-and-formatting/formatting-your-paper/ (BMJ house style applies to all BMJ journals including BJSM); publisher and ISSN from Wikipedia; citation style cross-checked at Paperpile. Route to needs-headless-recheck.

encoding_notes: Live BJSM Instructions for Authors (bjsm.bmj.com/pages/authors/) returned HTTP 403 (bot-blocked); web.archive.org and archive.ph both unreachable via WebFetch. No live/archived BJSM page could be read.

Formatting/reference/figure values encoded from the authoritative BMJ cross-journal author hub (authors.bmj.com/writing-and-formatting/formatting-your-paper/), which BMJ applies to all its journals including BJSM. These are BMJ house style, not a BJSM-specific page read.

in_text: BMJ formatting page states references may be 'square brackets [6] or superscripts'; Paperpile CSL for BJSM shows square brackets. Encoded 'bracket'; superscript is ALSO permitted per BMJ house style (BJSM's rendered/production output is typically superscript).
et_al_threshold=3 from BMJ house style: 'The first three authors are listed by last name and initials, with additional authors acknowledged by the use of et al.'
include_doi=true: BMJ references include DOI when available.
journal_abbrev='nlm' inferred from Vancouver style (NLM/Index Medicus abbreviations); not explicitly restated on the fetched page.
Figures: BMJ requires min 300 dpi for non-vector images and 1200 dpi for line art — SCHEMA GAP: schema holds a single min_dpi (encoded 300, the general minimum); line-art 1200 dpi not representable.

article_types reflect BMJ/BJSM standard offerings (original research, systematic reviews, reviews, editorials, letters) corroborated by multiple secondary sources; NOT read from an enumerated live BJSM list because the page was blocked. BJSM does not focus on case reports/case series, so those were omitted.

abstract.structured=true: BJSM original-research abstracts are structured (well-established BMJ convention, corroborated by secondary template summaries); exact section labels and word cap were NOT verifiable from the live guide (null).
word_limits and sections left empty {}: no BJSM-specific per-article-type word/reference/figure caps could be verified from any reachable source.
title_page.elements limited to the near-universal BMJ set (title, authors, affiliations, corresponding author, manuscript word count); exact BJSM title-page composition unverified.

blinding all false: BMJ journals use multiple peer-review models and each specifies its own; BJSM's specific model (and any author-anonymization requirement) could not be verified, so conservative false was used. Do not assume double-blind.

declarations: BMJ adopts ICMJE Recommendations (competing interests, funding, ethics approval, contributorship, data availability) but the exact BJSM declaration set/order was not readable; left order=[] / required=null.
[schema-required default] figures.legends_location defaulted to 'in_text' (guide silent; legends left where authored).
